rca_of_the_issue: Verified the documented RCA matches the source: Anthropic's strict pairing rule (tool_use must be immediately followed by tool_result blocks in the next user message) was being violated by an unconditional `messages.append({'role':'user','content':[{'type':'text','text':_verif_msg}]})` after each tool_result. The fix now branches on provider and, for Anthropic, mutates the existing tool_result block's content (string concat or list append depending on the existing content shape). For the discovery gate, the system-prompt addendum alone was advisory — the LLM ignored it under load. The server-side gate in _exec_tool is now authoritative and returns ok=False+error so the AI gets a clear, repeatable instruction to call save_discovery_answer instead of construction tools. The visual_skeleton stage test confirms the gate does not over-fire.
